exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold the weight at the chest, sit between the hips, keep the chest tall.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Push the hips back, bar stays close, stop when the hamstrings bite.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.cue: Back knee straight down, front shin near vertical.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Body in one line, elbows about 45 degrees from the ribs.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.cue: Squeeze the shoulder blades first, then pull the chest to the bar.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, press slightly back so the head clears.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Squeeze the glutes; the hips should not sag or pike.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.cue: Stack the feet and lift the hips until the body is one line.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, drive through the heels, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.cue: Lower as slowly as you can control; push back up with the hands.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, hold a second at the top.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.cue: Top leg on the bench, lift the hips and hold square.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.cue: Tall posture, shoulders down, do not let the weights swing.

exercises.name: Med Ball Slam
exercises.cue: Full extension overhead, then throw down as hard as you can.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.cue: Land soft in a quarter squat; step down rather than jump down.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Lower back pressed flat throughout; move slowly.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Pull to the forehead, thumbs back, pause at the end.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.cue: Step wide, sit into that hip, keep the other leg straight.
